description: FX rates: daily exchange rates for USD, EUR, ARS, BRL and 160 currencies. 0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base), first 10 calls/day per IP free; an unpaid call returns the x402 payment requirements. Free sample: textokit_sample.

payment_signature.description: Optional, legacy: base64 x402 v2 payment payload. Preferred: params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key.

quotes.description: Comma-separated quote currencies, 1 to 20 ISO 4217 codes.
